title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: New 28+ License Key for On-Premises (license key version update)
summary: Business Central On-Premises licensing changed effective October 1, 2026. Starting with version 28, all releases use a single forward-compatible license key version (28+) instead of version-specific keys, though customers must download a refreshed key before upgrading to each new version.
key_points: BC28 and later use unified 28+ license key instead of version-specific keys like v27, v26
Customers must download a new 28+ license key before upgrading to each new BC version
Download date determines which objects are unlocked, not the license version number itself
Earlier version-specific license keys for BC27 and earlier remain unchanged
Release cycle and support dates are unaffected by this licensing change

quotes.text: 28+ is a unified license key version, not a license file that automatically supports all future versions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical distinction that prevents misunderstanding about automatic forward compatibility of downloaded keys
